title: DVMA vulnerability module
description: One entry under a category's `vulnerabilities:` list in config/registry/categories/. tool/generate.dart is the authoritative validator; this schema documents the same contract declaratively for editors and the pre-commit/CI fast path.

id.description: Unique snake_case id across the whole registry; used for the slug, router key, screen path, and automation ids.

title.description: Human-readable module name shown in the app and docs.

difficulty.description: Relative exercise difficulty; drives list sort order within a category.

severity.description: Optional qualitative severity. Add only when there is a defensible rating; the CWE/MASWE/OWASP mappings remain the primary severity signal, so never fabricate one to fill the field.

masvs.description: At least one MASVS control, e.g. MASVS-CRYPTO-1.

maswe.description: At least one MASWE weakness id, e.g. MASWE-0007.

cwe.description: At least one CWE, e.g. CWE-327.

owasp_mobile.description: OWASP Mobile Top 10 category, e.g. M10.

owasp_llm.description: Optional OWASP LLM Top 10 category; add only when a genuine mapping exists.

owasp_agentic.description: Optional OWASP Agentic threat mapping; add only when a genuine mapping exists.

detail.description: Longer explanation rendered into the module's docs page.

display_tags.description: Optional curated badge labels; defaults to cwe + masvs + owasp_llm + owasp_agentic when omitted.

tools.description: Cross-platform tooling used to verify the module.

attack_inputs.description: Inputs the tester authors to drive the module.

platforms.description: Platforms the module applies to. Omit for a shared module (defaults to both).

platform_note.description: Note explaining how a shared module differs per platform.

manual_test.description: Optional external/manual verification step the in-app integration suite cannot drive; rendered into the Manual Testing checklist.

observe.description: How to watch the demo take effect (log filter, pulled evidence file, or the CI regression test that guards it).

real_demo.description: Optional pointer to an end-to-end demo script for the module.
